name: Restoration
line: Physician-led clinics in Thornhill and Woodbridge, built across five service lines.
about: Restoration Medical is a physician-led clinic group in Thornhill and Woodbridge, Ontario.
Its world holds five service lines under one name: family medicine, a pain centre, medical aesthetics, infusion therapy, and rehab and recovery.
alt: Folded white linen and a surgical steel instrument on black marble

built.Lore: Branding, naming and positioning for five service lines under one name, with brand guidelines the team follows.
built.Law: Ads, posts and site copy reviewed against CPSO, CNO and Health Canada rules, plus pricing and treatment packages.
built.Language: Social media, a content strategy across five service lines, paid ads, video and on-camera content, and email and SMS.
built.Map: The website, Google Business Profile, SEO and online booking.
built.Ground: Signage in the Thornhill and Woodbridge clinics, and content for the screens in the waiting rooms.
built.Artifacts: Forms, business cards, brochures and patient handouts.
built.Machinery: Online intake forms, CRM, AI and automations for reminders and follow-up, and reporting.
